Caps coal capacity at ~20.5 GW operational; cancels/postpones 15+ planned coal projects. Targets 14.7 GW gas/LNG capacity by 2030 (vs. ~7.8 GW operational gas in 2023).

- **Key Actors**: MOIT (policy/approvals); EVN (grid + ~60% thermal ops); PVN (gas/LNG development); IPPs/BOTs (majority of coal capacity).  
- **Critical Challenges**:  
  - Grid congestion in South Central Coast (Binh Thuan, Ninh Thuan) limiting thermal dispatch (EVN Grid Operation Report 2023).  
  - LNG terminal delays (Thi Vai FSRU, Son My) impacting gas project timelines (IEA *Southeast Asia Energy Outlook 2023*, p. 89).  
  - Financing constraints for new thermal under JETP scrutiny; focus shifting to repowering/retrofits.

| Vinh Tan 1 / *Nhiet dien Vinh Tan 1* | Binh Thuan | Coal | 1,200 | Operational | 2017–2018 | "BOT project commercial operation confirmed" (MOIT Investment Certificate No. 78/GP-DK, 2014; PVN Press Release, 15 Dec 2017) | HIGH |
| Duyen Hai 3 / *Nhiet dien Duyen Hai 3* | Tra Vinh | Coal | 1,200 | Operational | 2016–2017 | "Units 1 & 2 commissioned Q3 2016/Q1 2017" (PVN Project Completion Report, Ref: PVN/BC-DA.03, 10 Mar 2017) | HIGH |
| Phu My 3 / *Nhiet dien Phu My 3* | Ba Ria-Vung Tau | Domestic Gas | 720 | Operational | 2004 | "2x360 MW gas turbines operational since 2004" (PVN Gas Power Division Profile, 2021) | HIGH |
| Thai Binh 2 / *Nhiet dien Thai Binh 2* | Thai Binh | Coal | 1,200 | Under Construction | Expected 2025 | "Construction progress 75% as of Dec 2023; COD delayed to Q4 2025" (MOIT *Report on PDP8 Implementation*, internal briefing cited in *Tuoi Tre*, 28 Feb 2024) | MEDIUM |
